scope: Disposable local fixtures only; no original/snapshot edits, no deployment, no real approvals or external sends.

results.observation: The rendered diagram changes, but the actual publication gate reads record fingerprints and approval booleans only; it does not bind this dependency to review.
The documented build prerequisite executes tests that require every actual record to remain draft/unreviewed. The approved fixture therefore fails before publication can proceed.
The same CONTENT_APPROVED/SITE_INDEXABLE booleans generate an indexable artifact after authored content changes. No revision-bound approval or invalidation exists.
